calls.head: Thompson gets company tonight
calls.body: At home, the Lightning keep sending Cirelli’s line (Mikheyev, Cirelli and Holmberg) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jon Cooper has been giving this group the hard job of facing the other team’s top line. Tonight the Sabres’ first line is Benson, Kulich and Thompson.

calls.head: Don’t buy Luukkonen’s slump against the Lightning
calls.body: Luukkonen has been shaky against the Lightning since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.

story.head: The Sabres pile it on the Lightning
paras: Jiří Kulich struck first for the Sabres early in the first, but Nikita Kucherov tied it 1-1 for Tampa Bay on the power play midway through the period. Jack Quinn put the Sabres back ahead 2-1 early in the second. Tage Thompson stretched the lead to 3-1 on the power play midway through the period. He scored again late in the period to make it 4-1, his fourth straight game with a goal. Gage Goncalves cut Buffalo’s lead to 4-2 early in the third, and Noah Östlund pushed the lead to 5-2 a minute later. Zach Benson added an empty-net goal with just over a minute left to make it 6-2. He finished with a goal and two assists.

The Lightning had a little more of the play, but the Sabres had the finish. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen made 29 saves for the Sabres, and Dennis Hildeby allowed five goals on 27 shots. The Sabres improved to 10-10-4, sixth in the Atlantic, while the Bolts fell to 15-6-2, second in the Atlantic.
